name: Mayoineko o Tomeyou
source:
Late at night, the chime suddenly rings in the apartment of a man who lives alone.
What if a beautiful girl, for some reason, is standing at the entrance soaking in the rain and asks to stay the night...?
She says that instead of the girl doing naughty things, she wants her to stay the night.
And the virgin man's heart is shaken.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ171019.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
深夜，独居男人的公寓突然响起门铃。

如果一名美丽女孩不知为何淋着雨站在门口，请求留宿一晚，会发生什么？

她说，与其让女孩做下流的事情，不如让她留宿。

处男的心因此动摇。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ171019.html]DLsite[/url]]
